insert-values-upsert.sql: INSERT INTO "app"."account" ("id", "name") VALUES ($1, $2), ($3, $4) ON CONFLICT ("id") DO UPDATE SET "name" = "excluded"."name" RETURNING "id", (old."id" IS NULL) AS "inserted"

insert-select-do-nothing.sql: INSERT INTO "app"."account" ("id") SELECT "id" FROM "staged" ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

insert-constraint-set.sql: INSERT INTO "app"."account" ("id", "name") VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT "account_pkey" DO UPDATE SET "name" = $3, "note" = "excluded"."note" WHERE "name" <> $4

insert-expression-target.sql: INSERT INTO "app"."account" ("id") OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE VALUES ($1) ON CONFLICT ("id", LOWER("name")) WHERE "active" = $2 DO NOTHING

insert-typed-values.sql: INSERT INTO "app"."account" ("small", "missing", "mood") VALUES ($1, $2, CAST($3::text AS app.mood))

insert-with.sql: WITH "src" AS (SELECT "id" FROM "staged") INSERT INTO "app"."account" ("id") SELECT "id" FROM "src"

update-versions-renamed.sql: UPDATE "app"."account" SET "name" = $1, "visits" = "visits" + $2 WHERE "id" = $3 RETURNING WITH (OLD AS "before", NEW AS "after") "before"."name" AS "was", "after"."name" AS "now"

update-where-twice.sql: UPDATE "app"."account" SET "a" = $1 WHERE "b" = $2 AND "c" = $3 RETURNING new.*

delete-using.sql: DELETE FROM "app"."account" USING "gone" WHERE "gone"."id" = "app"."account"."id" RETURNING old.*

delete-as-cte.sql: WITH "moved" AS (DELETE FROM "app"."account" WHERE "id" > $1 RETURNING "id") , "kept" AS (UPDATE "log" SET "seen" = $2 RETURNING "id") SELECT * FROM "moved"
